Players Committee card image of [[The Dead Speak!]] (first published image; no errata mark), printing: “If I Will Finish What You Started on table, deploy on table. May ▼ Sith Throne. While [Episode VII] Emperor on Exegol, attrition against opponent is +2 at same location as Kylo, Pryde, or Rey. Your [Episode I] characters are lost. [Immune to Alter.]” Uploaded unchanged.

Source: the Players Committee Holotable image set, file [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/c241f88/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual14-Dark/hires/thedeadspeak.png Images-HT/starwars/Virtual14-Dark/hires/thedeadspeak.png] as of commit c241f88 “vset14” (18 March 2021).
